notes.title: Fixed issues
notes.content:
Fixed issues:

Fixed the use of 'bomb into the void'. In some situations, this caused the client to crash.
Fixed the reloading of the pistol. In certain combinations of computer performance and network conductivity, reloading caused a race condition.
Fixed a cosmetic bug during scrolling. Now the game field doesn't flip even if you play around with it.
Fixed a cosmetic bug where the camera would 'detach' from the player.
Fixed a cosmetic bug where the end-game text was not fully displayed.
